The field side, six calmer ways

The static side of the collection section, with the tea field shown in other ways. The right side is the current tea panel, so you can judge each option next to it. Each frame scrolls for real.

Option
Screen

Framed tile משבצת

The field becomes one framed photo tile, like the tiles in the red hero, with the title, intro and arrow sitting flat on cream underneath. Slightly less colour than the original.

Good

  • The field stays visible but is contained in a frame, so it stops shouting
  • Feels like the hero tiles
  • Clear order: picture, then words

Watch out

  • The photo is smaller, so its softness shows less but it also carries less
  • Cream side next to a bold colour panel

Washed out דהוי

The same full-height photo, but drained of its neon: low saturation and a cream veil, with the card on top as before.

Good

  • Closest to what you have now, so the least to relearn
  • The field is still a big presence, just a quiet one
  • Works with any colour panel on the right

Watch out

  • Still a large photo, so it must be a good one
  • Can look flat or milky if the veil is too strong

Dark green ירוק כהה

The photo turned into a dark green-grey texture on ink, with the title and intro in cream directly on it. No card.

Good

  • No bright green at all, so it cannot clash with the red or blue panels
  • Calm and premium
  • The field is felt as a texture rather than a picture

Watch out

  • You lose the freshness of the green
  • Dark panel next to the colour panels

Band and ink פס וכהה

A wide, slightly muted photo band across the top, then an ink block with the title and intro.

Good

  • The field is a clear, honest picture without a card on top of it
  • The dark block gives the text a calm place to sit
  • Easy to build

Watch out

  • Splits the left side into two halves
  • The band is a crop, so less of the field is seen

Letters אותיות

The giant letters 茶園 (tea garden) are filled with the photo of the field. Everything else is cream.

Good

  • The field is present but only inside the letters, so nothing neon fills the panel
  • Very much the brand: big Japanese type
  • Feels designed, not like stock photography

Watch out

  • The photo inside the letters is abstract, you see texture rather than a place
  • Needs a heavy font to look good, tested only with the system Japanese font

Slit חריץ

A tall, narrow strip of the field beside the text, framed by the same thin line as the tiles.

Good

  • The field is one slim frame, easy to live with
  • Leaves most of the panel for the title and intro
  • Looks like a window onto the farm

Watch out

  • The text column is narrower, so the title wraps more
  • The strip crops the field heavily
